newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba to hold news conference on April 17.
newsitem.headline: Buba to hold news conference on April 17.

text.p: The Bundesbank will hold a news conference on its 1996 balance sheet on April 17 after its regular council meeting, a spokesman said on Wednesday.
The Bundesbank said in January that it was likely to report a 1996 profit of about 11 billion marks. In 1995, the central bank announced a profit of 10.928 billion marks.
Almost all the Bundesbank's profit is transferred to the Bonn government. Bonn regularly budgets for seven billion marks in such transfers and uses any excess funds to pay off old debt.
